name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Hillsboro OR

fieldNotes.location: Roster address '2501 NE Century Blvd' geocoded (GEOMETRIC_CENTER) to an Intel-campus parking lot - wrong. Washington County tax record + OSHA inspection confirm GXO at 4800 NE 30th Ave, Hillsboro OR 97124 (parcel R2227009). A GXO monument sign at the development entrance off NE 30th Ave positively confirms the site in 2024-08 Street View. Coordinates relocated to the GXO building.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open development entrance drive off NE 30th Ave - no gate or guard booth at the property entrance. Individual dock yards have low chain-link separators but no controlled truck checkpoint was observed; entrance is essentially open. Counted as no gate.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: GXO occupies one of two buildings in the development (built ~2022, 270,000-360,000 sq ft, 27 dock doors per the Perlo Construction project record).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock band faces a shared central truck court; 27+ doors per the Perlo project record - banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Marked trailer-parking stalls in the shared central truck court; trailers parked without tractors observed.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town site with farmland on the south and east, but within the Portland-metro / North Hillsboro Industrial Renewal Area surrounded by major distribution and tech facilities - classified Urban as part of the metro industrial fabric (low confidence).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide shared truck court provides ample interior staging before docks.
